outcome: School graduation (lower and upper secondary education)
finding: Children born by Cesarean section had lower odds of graduating from lower and upper secondary education, attending conscription, and had slightly lower grade point averages and intelligence scores compared to children born vaginally.
mod_finding: Children born by acute Cesarean section had lower chances of graduating from lower and upper secondary education compared to children born by elective Cesarean section.
